who: Makes a small paid app for amateur choirs on their own, and takes contract work two days a week to pay for it. An agent reads the support mail and drafts the replies.

moments.plot: Version 2 goes out next week, and the contract wants three days this week instead of two.

tasks.title: Test the import from the old version
tasks.notes: Rosa’s choir has 400 pieces. If it works for them, it works.

tasks.title: New screenshots for the store page
tasks.notes: Use the alto part. Everyone uses the soprano part.

tasks.title: Reply to the choir in Ghent
Invoice Mateus for the shop work

capture.title: Ask Rosa to try the new metronome

file.title: Check the tax on app sales abroad
file.notes: The store pays out in four currencies now. Mateus’s accountant may know.

dated.title: Submit version 2 for review
dated.notes: Build, notes, screenshots. Leave two days for a rejection.

repeating.title: Answer the support queue
repeating.notes: Oldest first. The agent has drafts waiting for most of them.

attachments.notes: Six screens, light and dark. The rehearsal view goes first.

tasks.title: Third contract day, at the shop
Post the release on the choir forum

agent.title: Group the beta feedback into themes
agent.notes: Ninety-two messages from eleven choirs. Which problems come up more than once?
agent.question: What should come first?
bodies: Two problems stop a rehearsal: the page turn lags on older tablets, and the import drops repeat signs. Fix both before the release.
Most choirs ask for the same three things: a bigger page-turn button, a rehearsal timer and shared notes for the section leader.
agent.otherBody: Ninety-two messages, grouped into six themes. Sorted your way: {answer}
agent.acceptance: You know what to fix before the release.

discuss.title: Tell Mateus about the third day
discuss.notes: He wants three days this week. Two is the deal, and the release needs the rest.
discuss.question: What do you want to say?
options: Three days, then back to two
bodies: Happy to help this week. I can do three days, and from next week we go back to two, because version 2 ships.
I would like to keep it to two days this week. Version 2 goes out and needs the rest. I can do an extra day the week after.
discuss.otherBody: Thanks for asking first. Here is what I can do: {answer}
discuss.handoff: Your next step: send it before lunch
discuss.acceptance: Mateus knows how many days to plan.

review.title: Group the beta feedback into themes
review.note: Six themes, each with the choirs that raised it.

review.title: Draft replies to the support mail
review.note: Fourteen drafts. Three need a decision from you.

faded: Rewrite the sync in one weekend
Start a list for choir directors
